game.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
game.blurb: Action RPG in which the ghost hunters Red and Antea work through the haunting cases of New Eden, from DON'T NOD, released 2024-02-11. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Red and Antea's journey through New Eden, with its key choices and its two possible endings for Antea. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Haunting Cases
chapters.summary: Solving every haunting case across New Eden.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Shelters, locked and cursed chests, Haunted Grounds, treasure maps, ritual sites, Bibles, old writings, Soul Grabbers and the secret passage in Bligh Manor.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Freezing, parrying, rifle weak spots, Outburst, Banishment, Fusion and fighting as both Red and Antea.

chapters.title: Gear, Levels and Completion
chapters.summary: Upgrading items up to rank 7, collecting all equipment, Pieces of Eight, reaching level 25 and unlocking every achievement.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1493640)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Banishers:_Ghosts_of_New_Eden

Fandom (banishers-ghosts-of-new-eden.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://banishers-ghosts-of-new-eden.fandom.com/wiki/Banishers:_Ghosts_of_New_Eden
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none is written, so nothing was used. Fandom: banishers.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; banishers-ghosts-of-new-eden.fandom.com answers the API, but its game page has only 2 linked pages ("Banisher" and "Wanderer Set DLC"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 12 of 43 Steam achievements are hidden (5 to 16); they sit in the main story chapter. The two visible ending achievements ("Death is a journey" and "Farewell my love") were also put in the main story. "Second Death" (defeat a Specter in the Void) and "A Farmer's Life" (ritual sites) were placed in combat and exploration, which is a judgement call. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low.
